    Read the end. Read the next man. Then take the ball yourself and make something happen.

    Turn your phone sideways for the widest view.

    How the option works

    One play, three people who might end up with the ball. You make two reads in about two seconds, then you're the runner.

    ✋Hold GIVE to snap. Keep holding through the exchange and the fullback gets it. Let go and you pull it back. ①Watch the end. Crashing in on the dive? Pull it. Sitting square or coming at you? Give it. ②Pulled it? Watch the next man out. Coming for you? PITCH. Running with the pitch man? Keep it. 🕹Left thumb steers whoever has the ball. Let go and he runs upfield. ↕Right thumb: swipe up or down to juke, back to spin, forward to hurdle. Tap to lower your shoulder and truck. 🧠Truck the small guys. Juke the big ones. Spin off a man coming from the side. Hurdle a man as he dives, never one standing up. 🎯Passing: tap SNAP. The camera goes up behind you (All-22) so you can see the routes. Two ways to throw (switch above the field before the snap): Drawback puts the QB higher; put your thumb by him and pull down (and to the side) to aim, the arc shows where it lands, let go to throw, and the bottom-left corner moves him. Flick: flick toward a receiver on the right side and it goes where he's headed; flick harder for a harder throw. Cross the line and you're a runner.

    Read help puts a ring on the two defenders you're reading and slows the exchange. Turn it off in settings when you've got it.
